content_of_post_to_comment: My writing advice to myself (hasn’t changed in 10 years): Start early. Meditate before. Disconnect from the internet. Wait out gaps in the flow (just look out the window or something). Stay off social media, before and during. Put your phone away, out of sight. Consume other art that inspires you (maybe writing, or music). Have a plan: Know which piece you’re going to work on ahead of time. Most of the time you should be continuing pieces, not starting them, because almost nothing publishable gets finished in one writing session! Get in touch with your emotions, tactile sensations, and primal desires. Writing is a cognitive exercise, but meaning and resonance come from something deeper. Most of what we strive for with writing — clarity, cohesion, artistry, soulfulness, authenticity — are embodied experiences. The more you feel them while writing, the more the reader feels them while reading!
